{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the column exists and is numeric
print('Columns:', df.columns.tolist())
print('biomarker_final dtype:', df['biomarker_final'].dtype)

# Check for missing values in biomarker_final
print('Missing values in biomarker_final:', df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum())

# Check the range of values
print('Min biomarker_final:', df['biomarker_final'].min())
print('Max biomarker_final:', df['biomarker_final'].max())

# Compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()
print('Mean biomarker_final:', mean_biomarker_final)"}
